items.prompt: Edit this illustration: enlarge the single burning eye in the background dramatically, so its almond silhouette spans about 75% of the image width and 40% of the image height, occupying roughly ONE THIRD of the entire canvas. Place it across the upper background behind the mage, with the mage's hat, raised arm and head occluding its lower area. Its huge eye shape should emerge from the existing molten fire, ember-orange iris and dark vertical pupil, with broken smoky edges and flame strokes crossing it. Keep it atmospheric and subdued, low contrast rather than a bright sharp outlined emblem. Only ONE eye, no face or monster body. Preserve exactly the male elf mage's identity, clothing, gesture, full body composition, purple hat lining and coat, glasses, boots, framing, hand-painted matte block brush style and colors. No text or frame.
